prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client regarding injuries sustained in a sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident and is now receiving medical care, and we expect the insurer to treat this matter with the seriousness it deserves.

Effective immediately, please direct all communication concerning this claim to this office. Our client should not be contacted by you, your adjusters, or any representative of your company. If anyone from your organization has already reached out to our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We also request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, telematics information, dash camera footage, repair estimates, and any other material in your possession. Please confirm in writing that this preservation request has been received and that the materials will be retained.
